game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the scarab scholar must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what desert bandits changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 3 examination practice: Algorithm synthesis: multiply every value by 4. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 9, operand 21.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Tracer' (Week 9 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mirage Road'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the caravan wagon using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The caravan wagon reached with actions_used <= 15.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the caravan wagon is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
